purpose: Separate first-party semantic anchor selection from deterministic verification against sealed OANDA calibration bars.

machine_verifiable_without_new_semantics.rule: entry-family timestamps must be within configured 09:30 <= America/New_York < 11:00
when close-above route is selected, observed candle close must be strictly above supplied rejection high
locked worked plan remains long after supplied 2CR rejection-high run
supplied target must be above supplied long entry prices
supplied bullish Order Flow leg-low stop anchor must be below supplied long entry prices

semantic_anchor_selection_not_machine_de.reason: first-party evidence establishes the worked 4h FVG context but repository evidence still lacks exact Arjo FVG geometry/selection rules
FVA is bounded high-to-low and ITH/ITL hierarchy is partially defined, but base Swing High/Low selection and exact relevant FVA choice remain unresolved
2CR branches are first-party supported but rejection wick/body thresholds and exact rejection-candle selection remain unresolved
the bullish leg low is explicitly the no-return/stop anchor, but the relevant leg is not algorithmically selected by direct evidence
the worked plan targets next ATH / PD Array, but complete PD-array construction and target tie-breaking remain unresolved
2-Sting is required by the seed, but exact semantic identification of each sting is not first-party machine-defined; only execution timing after an annotated second sting is preregistered

prohibited_shortcuts: third-party Arjo-inspired indicators as semantic authority
automatic anchor choice from protected holdout
required_resolution: Occurrence packets must carry explicit semantic anchors with independent provenance/consensus; the verifier may confirm those anchors against sealed bars but may not invent them.
